name: Design LLM Evaluation
summary: Design an LLM evaluation around real tasks, controlled judges, failure taxonomy, and decision thresholds.
description: Design or audit an evaluation for an LLM feature, agent, retrieval flow, or prompt using representative tasks, reference evidence, deterministic checks, calibrated judges, uncertainty, and release decisions. Do not use it to tune prompts or certify a model, and do not run model calls without separate execution authority. Use before comparing models or claiming quality improvement.
risk_reason: This skill designs an LLM evaluation around real tasks, controlled judges, failure taxonomy, and decision thresholds; it does not declare one model universally better from a narrow benchmark.
refuses: It does not fabricate ground truth, use private data without authorization, or tune on the held-out set.
It does not declare one model universally better from a narrow benchmark.
It does not hide safety regressions, judge disagreement, cost, latency, or failed cases.

operational.latency_reason: The skill designs an LLM evaluation around real tasks, controlled judges, failure taxonomy, and decision thresholds, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
